title: [review] tx_queue.py:410: confirm_transmitted() does not
description: _remove_first() (called by confirm_transmitted) removes the entry and updates transmission stats but never signals the reservation as successful. Since confirm_transmitted() is called after 'the radio confirms transmission' (per docstring), it should call entry.reservation.set_result(True) on success. This is inconsistent with complete(success=True) which correctly signals the reservation at line 496-497.
close_reason: Fixed: _remove_first() now signals entry.reservation.set_result(True) before updating stats, matching complete(success=True) behavior
